game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Festival Grounds, the festival grounds: the herald must handle siege rats while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Swap Switch: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute apples without losing either value.
theme: The Kingdom – Festival Grounds: the festival grounds
core_gameplay_loop: In Festival Grounds, repeat each round: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute apples without losing either value. Each round, siege rats strike the throne, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the a value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the throne from siege rats in Festival Grounds: keep the a meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 76-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: a drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 76-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 9 (extended tier): Swap Switch
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Swap Switch' (Week 1 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Festival Grounds'.
